name: bgp.tools
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator with public documentation and several years of public track record (A8 community; P047 chair: 'tier community is the lowest dataset operator (IPtoASN, bgp.tools)').

reliability.justification: AS names and network classes curated from routing data; the class labels (Eyeball/Content/Carrier) are heuristics.

asns.title: bgp.tools asns.csv (AS number, name, class, country)

terms.quote: Registry terms: DB-IP Lite CC BY 4.0 (open), IPtoASN PDDL (open), bgp.tools free use with descriptive UA (open), GeoLite2 EULA (license).

asns.notes: Quote: binding council text (P047 cond 7); research C0097 terms 'bgp.tools terms (free use, descriptive UA required)' (verified_live 200). asns.csv only (no other path is ever fetched), at most daily, with the contact User-Agent of the http_profile (setting contact_email = the team role mailbox, never an analyst's address; without it the source is SKIPPED 'config', P047 cond 5). Used by ip_offline_db.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-2 (P047). The contact User-Agent is a binding host profile (providers.PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS: bgp.tools -> 'contact').
